decisions.reason: Because this recruitment service remains distant from the firm's announced maritime strategy and shows no visible reinforcing result after two years, even commitment-prone management is likely to refocus resources on core maritime offerings.
This superyacht crew service builds directly on the firm's established crewing capabilities, so sunk investment, strategic fit and public commitment all support continued backing.

The maritime education programme is new, has already expanded to a six-institution partner network, and fits the firm's training assets and integrated maritime direction, which encourages persistence.
These emissions monitoring and compliance services are close to the core business and already show a concrete execution success, making withdrawal very unlikely for commitment-oriented management.

The emissions compliance dashboard is tied to the firm's digitalisation and environmental strategy and is integrated into its PAL software, indicating visible investment that management will want to justify.

The emissions compliance cost simulation tool supports the same regulatory and digital push as the dashboard, and its integration into existing software makes continued commitment more likely than exit.
